name: Icon
summary: Shows one semantic icon from the active set, drawn in the current text colour. The library's own outline set is the default; a theme can draw the same names from a curated MIT or Apache-2.0 library (`setIconSet`, owner Q36), and a name that library lacks falls back to its first style, then to the library's own. Not for decoration, and never the only label of a control without an accessible name.
a11y: Decorative by default (`aria-hidden`); with `label` it becomes `role="img"` with that name. Icons that point along the reading direction mirror in right-to-left contexts, whichever set draws them.

props.name: name
props.description: Semantic name from the active icon set.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for a meaningful icon. Omit when the icon sits beside words that say the same thing.

props.name: size
props.description: Size by context: `sm` inside small text, `md` beside body text and in controls, `lg` standalone.

props.name: from
props.description: Draws from this library and style instead of the active one: only for showing libraries side by side (the Icon page's set cards).
